questions.question: Name two jobs people do on a farm and two jobs people do in a village.
questions.expected_answer: On a farm people work as farmers, farmworkers, tractor drivers or milkers. In a village people work as teachers, nurses at the clinic, shopkeepers or builders.

questions.question: Why do towns and cities have more kinds of jobs than farms and villages?
questions.expected_answer: Towns and cities have many more people and many more buildings, such as shops, banks, offices, factories and hospitals. Each building is a workplace, and the many people need many services, so there are more kinds of jobs.

questions.question: Give one reason why jobs are different from place to place, with an example.
questions.expected_answer: Jobs depend on what the land offers. For example, people mine where there are minerals, such as platinum in Limpopo, and people fish where there is a sea. Jobs also depend on how many people live there and what buildings there are.
